about: Dated changes in HOW the lesson numbers are counted. The newest entry is written into docs/data/lessons.json as "method_change" (scripts/build_lessons_page_data.py) and every trend / progress view that plots Words % or Grammar % over lessons shows it (docs/js/lesson-math.js methodHtml / stampMethod). Hand-made; add an entry, never delete one. No entry may call a change an improvement: a method change only says the numbers are not comparable.

changes.text: From 2026-10-05 these numbers are counted on a second AI listen of your lines and a new read of every lesson; earlier and later values are not comparable.
changes.why: Three lessons where almost no line was re-heard (no separate microphone track) still lost 50 slip rows, so most of the change comes from the new read of the lessons, not from better hearing.
changes.by: Codex final approval + council final approval 2026-10-05 (data/lesson-work/rehear/reviews/)
